result.description: Aurora Loom is a fictional desktop monitor designed for color-critical illustration, layout, and soft-proof review in compact studios. It combines a 27-inch IPS panel, QHD resolution, and a factory-calibrated wide-gamut profile tuned for print-oriented workflows rather than gaming or general office use. The stand offers height, tilt, swivel, and pivot adjustment, while the chassis includes a matte anti-glare finish, USB-C upstream connectivity, and a simple three-button on-screen menu. It is not associated with any real manufacturer or product line.
